meta.purpose: Candidate ids manually confirmed as wrong/redundant and removed from site/data/events.json -- checked by decide.mjs alongside live events so a candidate deleted here doesn't just get silently re-extracted and re-published on the next run. Deterministic candidate ids mean the same real bug re-produces the exact same id every time, so this list is effective without needing content fingerprinting.
meta.howToAdd: Add the candidate's own id (not the live event id, though for auto-published candidates they're the same) plus a one-line reason when you remove a bad auto-published entry.
